description: This file defines the 'EndpointResourceResult' class, which extends 'AbstractEndpointResult' and implements a 'normalize' method that returns the normalized object data. It's part of the API V2 namespace for the OrangeHRM Core plugin, serving as a representation of API endpoint results.

classes.name: EndpointResourceResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an API endpoint resource, providing a normalization method.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized array representation of the object by calling 'normalizeObject'.
